conviction_note: Q3 is close to a non-event on the numbers (first GeoBlock reached COD on 30 Sep, consensus revenue $0.1m), so the reaction turns on the first call since the 6 Oct Morpheus short report, the 2027 revenue range ($60-80m, 'not formal guidance', curtailment risk) and positioning: ~23.6m shares short (about 29% of the ~81m IPO float) against a lock-up that frees ~205m shares on or about 10 Nov, one session after the window. Those pull in opposite directions, so p_up sits at 52 on a 14% absolute move (implied 12.2%, raised for the crowded short, the short-report rebuttal and a possible first formal 2027 guide). The findings sum (+1.3) is larger than the scaled number (+0.56) because the positive squeeze/rebuttal finding is sized on its own and the lock-up supply that offsets it sits outside the window by the company's own date.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS -$0.10 and revenue $0.1m, Zacks preview 2026-11-04 (https://finance.yahoo.com/energy/articles/fervo-energy-q3-earnings-preview-135700498.html); single source, not company guidance, so findings resting on the EPS/revenue bar are capped small. The line the stock trades on has no sourced consensus: Q4 revenue 'mid-single-digit millions' per third-party analysts quoted on the Q2 call (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/fervo-energy-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-12/) and the company's own non-guidance 2027 revenue range of $60-80m. print_vs_bar_pct is 0 because Q3 revenue is immaterial (COD 30 Sep) and the bar is one vendor's.
positioning_check: Short interest 23,603,475 shares at the 2026-10-15 FINRA settlement, down from a 25,718,001 peak on 2026-09-30, days to cover 2.48; about 8.0% of 294.76m shares outstanding but roughly 29% of the ~81m shares sold in the IPO (97-99% of pre-IPO stock is under lock-up); next FINRA print 2026-11-10 (https://equibles.com/stocks/frvo/short-interest, read 2026-11-06). Massive also shows 23.6m and 2.5 DTC (https://massive.com/quote/frvo). Activist short Morpheus Research has been public since 2026-10-06. Baseline: 25d skew +3.38 vol points (downside paid, modest), put/call OI 1.2, ATM IV 128.5%, event-implied move 12.16%, 20d run-up -37.0%, 79.6% off the 52w high, 11% above the 52w low; closed 2026-11-06 at $8.59, +10.3% on the day, 5d +4.6%. Lock-up on ~205m shares ends 'on or about November 10, 2026' per the company's 10-Q.

findings.finding: First call since the 2026-10-06 Morpheus short report into a crowded short: ~23.6m shares short (Oct 15) against a ~81m-share free float (~29%), DTC 2.5; the company has so far only told Heatmap the claims are 'selective and outcome-driven', and it has scheduled a Cape Station investor open house for 2026-11-19, so the Q3 release and call are the first place management can answer the water-loss/thermal-decline claims with Cape Station data; any rebuttal with numbers into this short base is a squeeze mechanism inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print with a short report outstanding (two prints total: +3.6% on 2026-06-22, -16.6% on 2026-08-12). Since the report the stock has fallen from ~$13.4 to $8.59 with no company-level rebuttal.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected a data-backed rebuttal, short interest would have fallen faster than the 8% from its Sep 30 peak and the 25d skew would not still pay for downside (+3.38). The 37% 20-day slide after an ahead-of-schedule COD says the price holds the short thesis, not an answer to it.
findings.independence: Short report itself: https://www.morpheus-research.com/fervo/ (2026-10-06); company response quoted by Heatmap: https://heatmap.news/energy/fervo-short-seller-report; investor tour release 2026-10-16: https://www.stocktitan.net/news/FRVO/fervo-energy-invites-investors-to-see-the-world-s-first-commercial-tyraki68gdr9.html. Different sources, same direction only as to the setup, not to what management will say.

findings.finding: The Q2 call's 2027 revenue range of $60-80m was explicitly 'not formal guidance' and was cut for transmission curtailments on the lines serving Cape Station; Morpheus says the pathway the S-1 cited (290 MW) is being retired in June 2027 and Fervo told California regulators delivery needs new transmission. A Q3 call that formalises the 2027 outlook can land either side, and the last time this line was given the stock fell 16.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-08-12 (Q2), when the 2027 $60-80m range with curtailment risk first appeared: -16.59% (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: The range is public, but it was not guidance, so there is no sell-side number anchored on a company range; a formal guide (or silence) on Nov 9 is new information. If the market had fully priced a cut, the stock would not still carry 18 analysts with targets of $17-38.
findings.independence: Transmission dependence reported independently by Utility Dive 2026-06-05 (https://utilitydive.com/news/fervo-energy-geothermal-transmission-constraints/822141/); the June 2027 pathway retirement claim is Morpheus's (short-seller, conflicted). Sized down for the crowded short.

findings.finding: GeoBlock 1 (33 MW net, Shell offtake) synchronised 2026-09-24 and declared commercial operation 2026-09-30, one day before contractual COD and ahead of the Q2-call schedule that had it at 'full power toward the end of Q4'; GeoBlocks 2 and 3 are due by 2027-01-01. That puts a full quarter of 33 MW in Q4, consistent with or above the 'mid-single-digit millions' Q4 revenue third-party analysts cited on the Q2 call, and the Q3 release can confirm Q4 revenue/timing for GeoBlocks 2-3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The COD announcement itself (8-K 2026-10-01) was followed by a ~37% slide over the next five weeks, so this name has not paid for operational execution.
findings.why_not_priced: The COD is public and the stock fell after it, which is why this is sized small; what is not yet public is the first actual output/availability figure and the Q4 revenue run-rate, which would show up as estimate revisions after the call.
findings.independence: Company 8-K item 7.01 filed 2026-10-01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853868/000162828026064103/frvo-20261001.htm, per EDGAR submissions index); Q2 call schedule from MarketBeat summary above. Same company, two documents.

findings.finding: Funding gap: $2.11bn cash at 2026-06-30 against H2 2026 capex guided at $850-900m (FY ~$1.3bn) and $488m of open commitments, while Phase II (400 MW at a $5,500/kW target, ~$2.2bn) and the 396 MW Google PPA (COD from Q3 2028) still need funding; a project-debt, tax-equity or equity announcement could accompany the print or follow the lock-up. The money buys contracted capacity (1,054 MW, ~$11.9bn backlog), so it is a ramp, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No financing event at a prior print.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced; if the market priced an imminent equity raise the stock would trade below where a post-lock-up follow-on would be marketed, which cannot be observed. Sign left at 0 after asking what the money buys: corroborated contracted ramp (non-dilutive project debt would be positive, a post-lock-up equity offering negative).
findings.independence: Google 396 MW PPA 8-K 2026-09-01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853868/000162828026059707/frvo-20260826.htm) corroborates the use of funds. Same issuer.

findings.finding: Centaurus Capital (John Arnold) filed a Schedule 13G on 2026-10-27 for 15,293,504 Class A shares (5.3%), event date 2026-10-22, i.e. crossed 5% during the slide rather than as a pre-IPO holder (the pre-IPO 13Gs were filed 13-14 Aug); 15.3m shares is a large share of the ~81m tradable float and a buyer that absorbs supply.
findings.why_not_priced: A 13G is not wire copy and the stock kept falling after it (to the $7.63 low on Nov 5), so the buyer is not visibly in the price. It is inference that the stake was bought in the open market; the 13G does not say how it was acquired.
findings.independence: EDGAR submissions index shows the three Aug 13-14 13Gs from other filers (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001853868.json). Same EDGAR record.

findings.finding: Q3 EPS consensus is -$0.10 on $0.1m revenue (Zacks, ESP -22%, Rank #4); with the full ~295m post-IPO share count and Q2's $55.9m net loss as a guide, a headline EPS miss is likely, as in Q2 (-$0.38 vs -$0.09).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 EPS missed by 29 cents and the stock fell 16.6%, but that day also carried the 2027 curtailment range, so the EPS line's own effect is not separable.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Zacks itself predicts a miss. Pre-revenue name, so the EPS line is weak; capped small because the bar has a single source.
findings.independence: Q2 net loss $55.9m and share counts from the 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853868/000162828026056457/frvo-20260630.htm).

findings.finding: Sell-side targets are still 2-4x spot after a round of cuts (JPMorgan $38 to $27 on 2026-10-19, BofA $36 to $30, Baird $50 to $35, Morgan Stanley $23; consensus ~$38.5), so post-print target cuts are a likely headline flow on Nov 9-10.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: JPM cut on 2026-10-19 coincided with a -6% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Target cuts after a 68% slide are mostly expected; sized small and shrunk for the crowded short.

findings.finding: Peer read: Ormat (ORA), the listed geothermal operator, reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-04 with revenue +10.2%, a raised midpoint of 2026 revenue and EBITDA guidance, and an EGS pipeline expanded to 5-6 GW, a supportive read on enhanced-geothermal sentiment going into Fervo's call.
findings.why_not_priced: Proxy only: Ormat's earnings are mostly conventional geothermal and storage, so transmission to Fervo is sentiment, not numbers; FRVO did rise 10% on Nov 6, which may already hold it.

outside_window.finding: IPO lock-up covering ~97-99% of pre-IPO stock (~205m shares, roughly 2.5x the ~81m IPO float) expires 'on or about November 10, 2026' per the company's 10-Q; releases need J.P. Morgan and BofA consent. Supply arrives the session after the exit window; the anticipation is public (Morpheus, Quiver, lock-up calendars). Phase 0 of stage IPO measured lock-up sessions at a median +0.32% open to close.
Cape Station investor open house on 2026-11-19 (site walk, no formal presentations): any operating data shown there lands after the window.
FINRA short-interest update for the 2026-10-30 settlement is due 2026-11-10, after the print.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR submissions since 2026-10-01: no 8-K besides the COD 8-K; no S-3/S-1 or ATM filing (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001853868.json)
Form 4 cluster Oct 22 - Nov 4 (CEO Latimer, COO Jewett, CLO Torres): option exercises and a Class A-to-B exchange only, no open-market buys or sales
Cause of the Oct 30 -8% and Nov 6 +10% days: no company news found (MarketBeat alerts give none)

Company point-by-point rebuttal of Morpheus water-loss/seismicity claims: none found beyond Heatmap quote
Independent Cape Station output series (EIA-860M / Utah DOGM): not reached in the time available; COD announcement is the latest primary datum

baseline_tension: The skew (+3.4, downside paid) and the -37% 20-day run-up agree with the short thesis and the lock-up; the findings lean mildly against them on the crowded short and the first chance for a data-backed rebuttal, which is why p_up is only 52 and not higher.
lessons_applied: Lesson 7 (crowded short ~29% of float): shrank the negatives, 2027 guidance -1.0 to -0.7 and analyst target cuts -0.3 to -0.2.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the funding-gap finding moved from -0.5 to 0.0 because the money buys contracted capacity (1,054 MW, Google PPA), a corroborated ramp.
Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the early-COD finding moved from +0.5 to +0.3 because the stock fell ~37% after the COD announcement.
Lesson 5 (proxy): the Ormat peer read moved from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 6 (single-sourced bar, window): the EPS finding stayed capped at -0.3; the lock-up stayed in outside_window on the company's 10 Nov date.
p_up moved from 51 to 52 after the negatives were shrunk; abs_move_pct unchanged at 14.
